title: Cardinality of Hamming balls
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet, and regard a codeword of length $n$ as a function $\mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \alpha$, with the Hamming distance $d(x,y)$ counting the coordinates in which two codewords differ. For every radius $l$ and every center codeword $c$, the Hamming ball $B_l(c) = \{c' : d(c',c) \le l\}$ has cardinality
\[
\abs{B_l(c)} \;=\; \sum_{i=0}^{l} \binom{n}{i}\,(\abs{\alpha}-1)^{i},
\]
where $\abs{\alpha}$ is the number of symbols in the alphabet.
